title: Cartwise Shopper Payouts Training Notes: Earnings Debit Buffer on Debit-Card Cashouts
content:
**Payments desk training notes — Cartwise Shopper Payouts**

**The rule.** On an instant cashout to an external debit card, a debit buffer is kept back: an account with 3 or more earnings debits in the last 3 months keeps back 15.00, an account with 1 or 2 keeps back 7.50, and an account with none keeps back nothing. The buffer stays on the payout balance and is not sent in the cashout.

**Questions the rule answers.**

*What is an earnings debit?* The entry booked on the payout account when a batch tip reduction or a batch pay reversal is taken from the payout balance.

*Which debits count?* Those booked on the payout account fewer than 3 whole months before the day of the cashout ("the last 3 months").

*What does an account with exactly 2 debits keep back?* 7.50 — the 1-or-2 band.

*What does an account with exactly 3 debits keep back?* 15.00 — 3 is the lowest count of the top band.

*Does the size of the debits matter?* No. The buffer turns on the number of earnings debits only.

| Earnings debits in the last 3 months | 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 or more |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Buffer kept back | nothing | 7.50 | 7.50 | 15.00 | 15.00 |

**Hypothetical illustration.** An account shows earnings debits booked 10 days, 7 weeks and 3 whole months and 5 days before the cashout day. The last one falls outside the last 3 months, leaving 2 in the window: the buffer is 7.50.
